features.title: As a Service Agent, I want to search by a single-record identifier so that I can retrieve the correct customer and account summary quickly

openQuestions.text: What specific identifier types are supported for "single-record identifier" search (e.g., customer ID, account number), and what are their exact format/validation rules?
What is the exact API endpoint path, method, request/response schema, and versioning contract for the search/lookup operation?
Is field masking applied server-side (API response) or client-side (UI only), and what is the precise role-to-field masking matrix?
What specific error codes/taxonomy distinguish invalid input, no-match, and retrieval-error responses at the API level?
What are the exact role definitions and permission boundaries beyond "Service Agent" and "admin," and how do they affect which summary fields are visible or restricted?
What is the expected data retention period for audit events and search telemetry?
Is idempotency a requirement for repeated identical searches (e.g., caching behavior), and if so, what are the rules?
What constitutes "expected load" for the 2-second SLA (e.g., concurrent user count, request volume)?

features.title: Fraud Detection As a Compliance Officer, I want DemoIntern to retain and audit account management planning records and AI interaction evidence so that regulated banking reviews can verify who did what, when, and under which policy

openQuestions.text: Confirm whether the Compliance Officer audit/export review interface is part of the native mobile app, a separate web/admin console, or both.
What specific roles qualify as "approved support roles," and how is that approval granted/maintained?
What are the exact UI screen layouts, navigation flows, copy/tone, and accessibility requirements for the governed audit/records review interface?
What are the full request/response schemas, status codes, and idempotency behaviors for each listed API endpoint?
What are the specific retention period durations and disposition rules per record/policy class?
What fields constitute "unauthorized sensitive content" subject to masking/exclusion in exports?
Is a legal_hold table/workflow actually implemented, or only conditionally applicable "if applicable by policy"?
What is the defined "approved operational window" for nightly retention batch processing?

features.title: Edited As a Bug Management User, I want to record a bug for the DemoIntern project so that defects are captured with consistent and traceable information

openQuestions.text: What are the exact field length limits for title and description ("overlength" is referenced but no numeric limit is specified)?
What specific error response schema/status codes should be returned for validation failures and project-scope errors?
Is there a defined UI (web/mobile) for bug creation, or is this feature purely an API/service capability with no first-party client described?
What values/codes populate `bug_status_lookup`, `bug_priority_lookup`, and `bug_severity_lookup` for DemoIntern?
Is the create operation idempotent, or can duplicate submissions create multiple records?
What are the exact error responses/status codes for `GET /api/projects/{projectId}/bugs/{bugId}` when the bug or project is not found?
What is the data retention policy for bug records?
Are there additional actor roles (e.g., admin, auditor) with different permissions beyond the Bug Management User?
What sanitization method/library or rule set should be applied to title/description content?
